column1: # Title: Offshore wind resource types in GCAM-Europe

# Description: Maps each NREL ocean depth class to the offshore wind resource it feeds (fixed-bottom or floating) and to the electricity technology that consumes that resource (the key of the cost tables built in zgcameurope_L1233.elec_cost_data)
# Source: GCAM-Europe assumption (shallow and transitional depths -> fixed-bottom foundations; deep -> floating foundations)
